en.title: Thaw in Bosnia and Herzegovina: 600 km² of snow cover gone in a day
en.description: Thaw in Bosnia and Herzegovina: 600 km² of snow cover gone in a day
en.lede: Yesterday about 1,090 km² was white in Bosnia and Herzegovina; today 490 km² is left, 600 km² less in one day.

sections.h: A mild day eats the snow
p: Mild air hits the thin snow of the valleys first. Expect wet, heavy snow low down in the afternoon and firm, icy patches the next morning.
Snow covers roughly 490 km² in Bosnia and Herzegovina on 16 November, 600 km² less than yesterday. Roughly 2 % of the country's mapped mountains and hills are covered.

sections.h: How deep it is, height by height
p: Height makes the difference: between 500 and 1,000 m, under 1 cm on average, 2 % covered; between 1,000 and 1,500 m, under 1 cm on average, 2 % covered; between 1,500 and 2,000 m, under 1 cm on average, 3 % covered.

sections.h: The resorts with the most snow
p: Skijalište Kozara leads with 24 cm on its upper slopes.
Then come Igrišta olimpijski centar (20 cm), Ponijeri ski centar (20 cm), Ski centar Vlašić (20 cm) and Jahorina olimpijski centar (1 cm).
Igrišta olimpijski centar picked up 1 cm in the last three days and could add 0 cm by Thursday 19 November.
Snow lies on the upper slopes of 6 out of 12 resorts in Bosnia and Herzegovina.

The rest of the shortlist: Ponijeri ski centar: 20 cm on top, 1 cm in three days, 0 cm expected; Ski centar Vlašić: 20 cm on top, 1 cm in three days, 0 cm expected; Jahorina olimpijski centar: 1 cm on top, 2 cm in three days, 0 cm expected.
Expect up to 0 cm on the snowiest slopes by the third day; the seven-day total reaches 15 cm.
Monday 23 November stands out, with up to 11 cm in a day.
The second week adds up to 16 cm where it snows most.
The snow is retreating uphill, so plan on the higher lifts and avoid the low valley runs.
With more snow in the forecast, the next days should improve things further.
Below about 2,000 m the slopes are mostly green or brown. Last week's 200 km² has grown by 290 km².
Bjelašnica and Jahorina got the most fresh snow over three days, up to 3 cm.

For comparison, the neighbours on the same day: Croatia: 10 % white, deepest Rudnik Tršće with 17 cm, up to 9 cm in the week ahead; Serbia: 0 % white, deepest Avantura park with 28 cm, up to 8 cm in the week ahead.

advice: Roads to the higher resorts may need winter tyres or chains.
Check the resort's own lift status before you travel.
Fresh snow on a cold base sticks badly: take care on steep slopes.

bs.title: Snijeg u Bosni i Hercegovini danas: visina snježnog pokrivača i novi snijeg, 16. novembra 2026.
bs.description: Snijeg u Bosni i Hercegovini 16. novembra: snježni pokrivač, novi snijeg, visina po nadmorskoj visini, naredni dani i najbolji ski-centri.
bs.lede: Ponedjeljak, 16. novembra: snijeg pokriva oko 490 km² planina u Bosni i Hercegovini. To je 600 km² manje nego jučer. To je 2 % planinskog područja u Bosni i Hercegovini koje pratimo.

p: Teren je pretežno bijel od oko 2.000 m naviše. Prije sedam dana bilo je 200 km², pa je pokrivač porastao za 290 km².
Za tri dana najviše svježeg snijega palo je ovdje: Bjelašnica i Jahorina (do 3 cm).
Otopljenje topi pokrivač: ujutro tvrd snijeg, poslijepodne mokar.

Prosječna visina snježnog pokrivača po visini: 500–1.000 m: prosječno manje od 1 cm (2 % pod snijegom); 1.000–1.500 m: prosječno manje od 1 cm (2 % pod snijegom); 1.500–2.000 m: prosječno manje od 1 cm (3 % pod snijegom).
U naredna tri dana očekuje se do 0 cm, a za cijelu sedmicu do 15 cm.
Najsnježniji dan: ponedjeljak, 23. novembra, do 11 cm.
Kasnije, u danima 8–14, na najsnježnijim padinama može pasti još do 16 cm.
Prednjači Skijalište Kozara: 24 cm na gornjem dijelu staza.
Ski-centri sa snijegom na gornjim stazama: 6 od 12.
Slijede: Igrišta olimpijski centar (20 cm), Ponijeri ski centar (20 cm), Ski centar Vlašić (20 cm) i Jahorina olimpijski centar (1 cm).

advice: Prije skijanja van staza pročitajte lokalni lavinski bilten.
